task_description.overview: Compute and plot seismic ray paths on a spherical Earth projection for given distance and phases.
steps: Load the chosen Earth velocity model (e.g., iasp91).
Specify source depth, epicentral distance, and target phases.
Compute ray paths with the travel-time modeling tool.
Render the ray trajectories on a spherical projection.
Include legend and annotate phase names as needed.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Generate a spherical projection plot of seismic ray paths for distance 140° and source depth 500 km. Use iasp91 model and phases Pdiff and SS. Plot a figure to show the spherical ray trajectories. 
 Note: 1) the TauPyModel provide `get_ray_paths` to compute the rays and `arrivals.plot_rays` to plot the rays. 
 2) Save the ray path plot to {result_plot}.
